data.name: Manager.OutputModeHint
data.value: How this snippet is sent; “Follow global” uses the output mode from Settings.

data.name: Manager.AbbrConflict
data.value: Duplicate abbreviation of “{0}” — only one will fire

data.name: Trash.Hint
data.value: Deleted snippets are kept here for {0} days, then removed automatically. Restoring puts them back into their original category (recreated if needed).

data.name: Trash.EmptyConfirm
data.value: Empty the trash? Everything in it will be gone for good.

data.name: Settings.CaptureHotkeyHint
data.value: Silently saves the current clipboard text as a new snippet. Click, then press a combination; Delete clears it (empty = disabled).

data.name: Settings.AutoBackupHint
data.value: The data folder is zipped to this machine daily (newest 10 kept); a backup zip restores via “Import backup”.

data.name: Msg.AbbrConflicts
data.value: Duplicate abbreviations (only one fires each): {0}. Fix them in the Manager.

data.name: Manager.UseVarsHint
data.value: When checked, {variable}, {clipboard}, {date} and {cursor} tokens are processed on send; unchecked, the body is sent verbatim (best for code/scripts containing literal {…}).

data.name: Manager.LongLinePlainText
data.value: Line too long — shown as plain text

data.name: Manager.BodyVarsOff
data.value: Placeholders off · {0} {{…}} will be output verbatim

data.name: Manager.DuplicateAbbr
data.value: Abbreviation “{0}” is already used by “{1}” — expansion would be ambiguous

data.name: Settings.AbbrBlacklistHint
data.value: Process names separated by semicolons, e.g. cmd.exe; putty.exe

data.name: Msg.ImportConfirm
data.value: Importing will overwrite the current library. Continue?

data.name: Msg.ClearLibraryConfirm
data.value: This will delete every category and snippet (including the trash). It cannot be undone. Export a backup first if you need one. Continue?

data.name: Msg.ClearLibraryConfirmAgain
data.value: Confirm again: the library will be emptied permanently.

data.name: CatMgr.Hint
data.value: Drag to reorder. Batch add: one name per line; existing names are skipped.

data.name: CatMgr.InitHint
data.value: Adds the built-in categories and sample snippets for your language (Profile, Dev / Other prompts, Skills). Existing names are not overwritten.

data.name: Manager.DuplicateCategory
data.value: A category with that name already exists

data.name: Manager.SaveFailed
data.value: Couldn’t save — the data folder is read-only or in use by another program. Free it up, or pick a different folder in Settings.

data.name: Manager.DeleteCategoryConfirm
data.value: Delete category “{0}”? Its snippets will be removed too.

data.name: Settings.ClickToSendHint
data.value: In the search panel, a single click sends the snippet; by default you double-click or press Enter.

data.name: Settings.SummonTapHint
data.value: Click here and press a modifier (e.g. Right Ctrl); tapping it then summons the panel. Press Delete to clear. (A lone modifier can't be a normal hotkey, so it's detected by tap.)

data.name: Settings.AbbrPrefixHint
data.value: Prepended to every abbreviation (default ;). In the Manager type only the abbreviation itself (e.g. qm) — it triggers on prefix+abbr (e.g. ;qm). Leave empty for no prefix; a prefix keeps ordinary typing from triggering.

data.name: Settings.AbbrExpandHint
data.value: Type the prefix + abbreviation, then press Space, Tab, or Enter to expand it. Press Backspace right after an expansion to undo it back to the abbreviation you typed.

data.name: Settings.RestoreClipboardHint
data.value: Pasting briefly uses the clipboard, then puts back what you had copied. Off by default: apps that read the clipboard slowly can end up pasting the old content instead.

data.name: Msg.HotkeyTaken
data.value: “{0}” is already taken by another app — the panel won’t open until you set a different hotkey in Settings.

data.name: Msg.ConflictFiles
data.value: {0} sync conflict files were skipped — check them in the data folder, then delete

data.name: Msg.DataFolderUnavailable
data.value: Data folder unavailable (a removable or network drive may be disconnected). Started with an empty library for now — re-point it in Settings, or reconnect and relaunch.

data.name: Msg.SearchIndexFailed
data.value: Search index could not be built — the panel will find nothing for now. Your snippets are not lost; the Manager still lists them all. Relaunch to retry.

data.name: Search.Empty.Sub
data.value: Add your first snippet — then summon the panel anytime with the hotkey

data.name: Search.NoMatch.Sub
data.value: Try another keyword, or an abbreviation

data.name: Settings.HotkeyHint
data.value: Click, then press a key; ordinary keys need Ctrl / Alt / Shift / Win, function keys F1–F24 can be used alone

data.name: Settings.PortableHint
data.value: Keeps data in a Data folder next to the app — travels on a USB stick, leaves nothing on the host. The toggle creates the marker for you; takes effect after a restart, and needs the app in a writable location.

data.name: Settings.PortableRestart
data.value: Portable mode switched — restart to apply. Move your text library with Export / Import backup.

data.name: Settings.PortableFailed
data.value: Can't write next to the app (it may be in a read-only location like Program Files). Portable mode needs the app in a writable place, such as a USB stick.

data.name: Settings.CheckUpdatesHint
data.value: When on, the app contacts GitLab once at startup to check for and download a newer build to local disk. It never replaces the running program; this is the app's only network access.

data.name: Msg.UpdateCheckFailed
data.value: Couldn't check for updates. Try again later.

data.name: Msg.UpdateVerifyFailed
data.value: The downloaded file did not match the published checksum, so it was discarded. Please try again later.

data.name: Msg.UpdateReady
data.value: New version {0} is ready. The new program is at {1}. Quit the running program and copy it over to update.

data.name: Manager.UnsavedConfirm
data.value: You have unsaved changes. Save them?

data.name: Msg.HotkeyInvalid
data.value: “{0}” isn’t a valid hotkey — set a new one in Settings.

data.name: Msg.TargetLost
data.value: The target window wasn't ready. The content was copied to the clipboard; paste it manually.

data.name: Msg.NoTarget
data.value: Copied to the clipboard. Paste it manually, or open the panel from the input box and pick again to paste directly.

data.name: Msg.LibraryLoadWarning
data.value: Some files in the data folder could not be read; part of the library may be missing. See error.log for details.

data.name: Manager.StaleNotice
data.value: The library was updated in another window or outside the app. Your unsaved changes here have not been written to disk. Saving is paused; reload the on-disk version, or close and reopen this window.

data.name: CatJson.Hint
data.value: Edit this category’s snippet JSON. Saves are validated against the schema; you can also open it in the default editor or copy an AI prompt that includes the file path.

data.name: CatJson.NotArray
data.value: Root must be a JSON array (list of snippets)

data.name: CatJson.InvalidName
data.value: Item {0}: name must not be empty

data.name: CatJson.InvalidId
data.value: Item {0}: id is invalid (must be a GUID)

data.name: CatJson.InvalidOutputMode
data.value: Item {0}: invalid outputMode (allowed: empty, paste, paste-enter, copy)

data.name: CatJson.OpenFailed
data.value: Could not open the external editor

data.name: CatJson.FileMissing
data.value: File does not exist yet; it will be created on save

data.name: CatJson.AiPrompt
Skills.ImportHint
data.value: Multi-select favorited Skills to import into the current category. Snippet name and body come from the favorites JSON (body is the full SKILL.md path).

data.name: Skills.Hint
data.value: Browse Agent Skills under %USERPROFILE%\.agents\skills (tree). Favorites are saved to skills-favorites.json (name + full SKILL.md path); aliases are display-only. Import favorites as snippets from the Manager.

data.name: Skills.SelectHint
data.value: Select a Skill in the list
